app_name: ShatruKalan: Ancient Indian Warfare & Military Science
archetype: Luxury / Deep Historical Cinematic (Archetype 5 with Gold & Obsidian Vibe)
key_functionalities: Timeline-led Home dashboard with interactive chronological eras
15 exhaustive ancient Indian warfare sections with bilingual Hindi/English depth
Short preview cards with deep-dive modal panels on click
Interactive Vyuha formation explorer (Chakravyuha, Garuda, Makara, Krauncha)
Military Strategies, Siege Warfare & Naval Traditions deep dive
Audio-visual atmospheric effects and glowing cursor

image_urls.description: Chariot sculpture at night in golden illumination
Ancient temple wall displaying intricate stone carvings
Detailed ancient sculptural art with sword and shield motif

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning dark-themed React application with custom glowing cursor, smooth scrolling, bilingual Hindi/English descriptions, 15 comprehensive military modules, interactive timeline navigation, detailed popup modals, Vyuha formation visualizer, and immersive audio-visual polish. Use Tailwind CSS with custom gold and obsidian aesthetic. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header or overlays
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes
Support dark mode with custom tinted greys
